episodes.198095: Two nearby frontal boundaries ultimately promoted strong showers along the northern coast of Puerto Rico (among other areas), with rainfall accumulations ranging from 2 to 4 inches from Vega Alta to Quebradillas, and 1 to 2 from Rio Grande to Toa Alta. Some flooded roads was observed in Hatillo and Quebradillas.
episodes.198277: Early morning strong to severe storms formed across NE FL where instability increased from the south and coincided under moderate bulk shear. Wind damage occurred with stronger gusts of 45-65 mph.
episodes.198538: A brief northwest storm force wind gust was recorded at the Passage Island Light C-MAN station on the evening of the 17th.
episodes.198813: An approaching low pressure system on January 18th tightened the pressure gradient over the Gulf of Maine. This caused near gale force winds over the Gulf of Maine, with seas building to near 8 feet.
